name: Shared Field Display Settings
description: shares entity field display settings across all fields.
project_description:
Shared Field Display Settings (sfds) adds the ability to track and update field display settings and form display settings for fields that are opted in to sharing.

 How to use:

 
 Install as normal via Composer: composer require 'drupal/sfds:1.0.x-dev@dev' 
 Enable the module via Drush ( drush en sfds ) or via the UI (/admin/modules) 
 Consult your site's field list (/admin/reports/fields) to see which fields are shared (optional) 
 Edit the "storage settings" of a shared field. You will see a section labelled "Shared field display settings." 
 Activate the checkbox to "Enable shared field display for this field" 
 Choose "Global" or "Per bundle" for the "Shared field display mode" 
 Select a bundle from the list to use that bundle's field display settings as the global default 
 Save the storage settings
